INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE demo_dws.dws_lending_loan_summary_1d PARTITION (stat_date = '${bizdate}')
SELECT a.channel_code, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_no) AS loan_cnt
FROM demo_dwd.dwd_lending_loan_df l
JOIN demo_dwd.dwd_party_customer_info_df c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND c.dt = '${bizdate}'
JOIN demo_dwd.dwd_party_account_map_df a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id AND a.dt = '${bizdate}'
WHERE l.dt = '${bizdate}'
GROUP BY a.channel_code
